balls.text: good sharp bouncer, a tope edge goes straight up, but doesn't carry to deep midwicket. Time enough to get two
and even Umesh clears mid-off. You can't be providing them the length to clear the mid-off if you have the man up. Umesh has not even nailed the timing but enough to lob the man

finally Thakur finds a fielder. Siraj also bowls to his field for a change. Wide bouncer with the mid-off up. Thakur goes for the pull but there is no way to control it from that height and that line. Gets a big top edge to long-on. That ends a sensational innings from Thakur
Narine looks for the big slog to a length ball outside leg. Is beaten but gets the leg-bye to hand the strike back
wide full toss again, but this time Thakur ends up slicing it to deep point for one
poor bowling. Mid-off is up and he is bowling a wide full toss. Lofted over the infield for four more

misses out on the fifty but he has played an important hand. Harshal bowls the slower bouncer, Rinku tries to get inside the line to try to go over short fine, but ends up gloving it to the keeper. Shah Rukh Khan gives him a standing applause
slower ball, dipping full toss, draws an inside edge as Rinky comes down the track agai
flat flat six. It is a scorcher. Down the wicket, Harshal pulls the length back, gives him pace to work with, and Rinku pulls this over wide long-on for a parallel six
short and wide. Too wide. Called too
wide on the crease, goes pace-on, ends up bowling a full toss angling in, and Rinku just flicks it over midwicket for a big six
and now Rinku says you don't have to risk run-outs to get me off strike. Down the wicket, gets pace on, and lofts this length ball back over Harshal's head for four
the dipping slower ball, Rinku done in completely. Thakur wants to steal one but is sent back. Rightly so
wide length ball, Thakur throws his bat at it, but the slower ball beats him. Siraj is a little lucky with that one
slogs at this length ball, but is a little late into the shot. Gets a single to deep midwicket

is that too high? Yes it is. Siraj has missed the yorker so badly he has given them a high fullie. Also Rinku has ramped this for a six. Has all the pace to work with. RCB review the no-ball call. The replays show it is almost head high although he has gone low to play the ramp. Ball tracking shows it is clearly higher than the waist
Rinku charges at Siraj, and is beaten for pace as Siraj goes short of a length
short of a length, cuts back in, runs off the inside edge for one
drilled through mid-off. Poor bowling. Mid-off is up, and he has given him a half-volley outside off. He has played the mini helicopter to this to place it straight of mid-off
alarming bounce from short of a length. Unfortunate that he is too wide on line
Rinku gets Thakur on strike with a drop and run

ha ha ha, what a day Thakur is having. This is his third mis-hit that has landed safe. And this has gone a mile in the air, but still lands right between the man inside the circle and the one on the boundary, both of them running towards the each other. It is a top-edged pull. Ends up getting him two runs
slower full toss. It dips late to end up being a legal delivery but Thakur slaps it across the line for a four through square leg
full, outside off, driven to deep cover for one
slower bouncer, gets the front edge, but there is no one at mid-off, which is where this lands

there are four fielders on the leg-side boundary, and they can all just watch. Thakur pulls this from outside off, and pierces the gap between long-on and deep midwicket. That is fifty for Thakur. An innings that began with an ungainly shot to a wrong'un first up. Joint-fastest fifty this IPL
short of a length, outside off, steered away for a single
on a length, wicket to wicket, Rinku gets a leading edge for a single into the covers
big wide as Willey tries a slower bouncer. Way too high
slower ball, into the pitch, cuts away from Rinku, beats his pull
and when the lord mis-hits, he mis-hits it so bad it doesn't carry to the deep fielder. He is looking to go over extra but gets a thick edge over point for one
tries the ramp now, and is beaten

phew. Willey does everything right. Bowls short of a length to disallow him the length to clear mid-off, but Thakur slaps it back at the non-striker's head, who gets out of the way to let the ball beat mid-off for four more
on a length, just outside off, punched to extra cover. The rare dot from Thakur
anticipates a flat, wide delivery, and punches it to wide long-off for one
not to the pitch of the ball as he steps out, and the ball is turning, but that only means Thakur has some momentum to drag this over deep midwicket for a big six. This is some batting from Thakur

looks like a massive six when it comes off the bat but it has just cleared long-on. Down the wicket early, Bracewell looks to bowl flat, and even though he is not to its pitch, Thakur goes ahead with his swing. Big enough to clear long-on
slog-sweep but straight to deep midwicket on the first bounce
down the wicket, gets too close to the pitch of the ball, takes a single to long-on
reverse-sweeps a full ball from just outside off for one
stunning sweep. This is a wide legbreak, not even full enough to seep, but he has clobbered this into the ground. They even have a deep midwicket in place, but he stands no chance to field this
full, middle and leg, pushed to deep midwicket for one
Thakur goes back to punch this length ball to long-off for one
down the wicket, Karn goes wider, but Thakur catches up with it and slices it over cover for two more
full, on the stumps, driven down to long-on for one
wrong'un, outside leg, helped into the leg side for a couple
Thakaur capitalises on the free hit. Deep is probably looking for a yorker, and ends up a foot or so short. Thakur lofts it over wide long-on for six. What a little came Thakur is  playing
pulled down to deep midwicket for one. Hang on, he has overstepped
slower bouncer, Thakur upper-cuts it for a single to deep point
bouncer, pulled to long leg for one
short of a length, dabs on it for a single
inside--out over extra cover. Two proper shots from Thakur that specialist batters will be proud of. Nearly a six as he plays the aerial drive

that small boundary and that outfield is unforgiving. Akash goes on-pace, short of a length, into the pads, and Thakur plays a lovely glance. However, there is a fine leg in place, and that is hardly far from him, but the outfield beats Willey to his right
full toss, driven to long-off for one
defends a legbreak outside off
he has not picked the wrong'un at all. He is pushing at it for a legbreak, but it turns it. Thakur does get an inside edge, though, to dampen Karn's excitement

and his stay is short. Just one ball long. Russell is looking for a six first ball, and he gets a full enough ball, but he has not been able to connect properly at all. Easy catch for long-off, well off the boundary line. Not even close to a six

that is one way to get out. Almost nail the reverse-sweep but find short third with it. This is on a length, outside off, and he middles it with the reverse. Except that he has played it finer than he wants to. Straight to short third
down the wicket, beaten in flight, but still goes ahead with a big shot. Gets a thick inside edge to deep midwicket for two

that one loose ball, and Rinku takes full toll. If I am not mistaken, this is the first boundary hit by someone not named Gurbaz. This is well down the leg side, and is pace on, so all Gurbaz has to do is help it over short fine leg
dipping slower ball, low full toss, and he ends up hitting it straight to midwicket
slower ball, too full, driven down the ground, and Siraj makes a diving save to his left at mid-off. Saves three runs
on pace, punched to extra cover. Good timing but can't find the gap
quick couple. Just bunts a length ball towards long-on, and Gurbaz initiates the second and makes it
starts with a slower one. Rinku is beaten completely by it. Just outside off, and past the outside edge as he defends
misses out. Gets some width, but perhaps not short enough to cut. Beaten on the top edge
legbreak, middle and leg, nudged to short fine for a single
good length, legbreak, he opens the face and takes a single to short third
defends one just outside off
wow what a sweep. His shots all look like Ryan ten Doeschate's. Sweeps against the turn, from just outside off, and nails it for a flat six. That also brings up his fifty
turn for Karn too. Defends in front of off
and Gurbaz just nudges it for one into the leg side when Bracewell gets the length right
this one has been dragged short after he overpitched earlier. Gurbaz is quick to go back and pull this over midwicket for four. To the left of deep midwicket
this one slides on with the angle, Rinku punches it to long-on for one
punches this length-ball offbreak to long-on for one
overpitched. And Rahman is ready for it. This is excellent batting. The pressure is on the batting side, but he has punished the first error in length. Gets under it, and sends it over wide long-on
on a length, outside off, crunched away to deep cover
full, just outside off, defended back to the bowler
that is a good sweep. Takes it from wide outside off. No chance of an lbw here. And he nails it. Between deep square and deep midwicket
splice of the bat as he draws a forward-defensive
on a length, on the pads, worked into the leg side for one
flighted outside off, pushed to long-off for one

given first ball, and Gurbaz has reviewed immediately. Sweeping a straight ball, he is nearly done in by the turn, but he gets a big deflection off the glove onto the pads. The review brings Gurbaz back on
slightly short, slightly wide, dabbed past point for one
there is some turn for sure. Pushed into a hole in the leg side to come back for a second
this one goes straight on, pushed to long-on for one
some turn from a length from middle and off. Rinku defends to cover
offbreak, on a length, punched back to Bracewell

big appeal for a catch as Rana reverse-sweeps first ball. Not given on the field, and they review after much discussion. Replays show this has come straight off the glove. Rana shapes up fort the shot early, Bracewell gets some bounce to go past the top of the bat and take the glove to lob up for catch for Karthik
this one seams back in. Extra bounce too. Hits Gurbaz in the midriff
their field placements have been on point. Rana cuts to find out that deep third is square to allow him just the single
pitched outside leg, angles towards the stumps, Gurbaz drops and runs
quick to pounce on a short ball and pull it over midwicket for a four. Just the transfer of weight back as he swivels
this one swings in, defended in front of middle and leg
wobble seam. On a length, middle and off. Left alone to seam away through to the keeper
down the wicket, Deep gets some seam movement to deny him an aggressive shot. They do get in a single, though
bouncer. Again a just too high. Called wide
lovely touch. Shuffles across, gets slightly inside the line, and glances this length ball fine of short fine leg. Wow seems he has been denied the runs. It seems it has been called leg-byes
swings himself off the feet trying to hit this wide length ball after stepping out. Misses by some way
on a length, at the stumps, punched to mid-on
does well to not give him room and stays full enough to not let him get under. Gurbaz whips it to deep midwicket for two
gets inside the line of a short ball, and pulls it fine for a flat six. Uses all the pace of Akash Deep. Also a no-ball
gets away with a short and wide delivery. Kohli makes a good one-handed save at short point
defends a length ball. That is a double-wicket maiden
this one swings away, and is left alone
length ball, at the stumps, played towards that short midwicket, but with soft hands

and he is already the old batter. How has that hit the off stump? Left-arm quick, hitting the off stump of a right-hand batter usually happens when the ball is swinging back in or if the batter is going hammer and tongs. This one, though, is a wobble-seam delivery that lands on middle and off, seams away to beat Mandeep's defensive prod, and still manages to clip the off stump. Mandeep is squared up

timber. This has jagged back in to hit the middle stump. He has missed this by a long way. Willey stays on a length, just outside off, Iyer likes to play off the back foot, and tries to muscle it through the off side. The seam movement beats him by six inches at least
on a length, around off, Iyer punches it off the back foot to mid-on
looks like a slower ball, Gurbaz defends the length ball off the front foot
aggression from Siraj. A proper bouncer. Called a wide. Siraj wants a review, but du Plessis says no
this is poor bowling. His two deep fielders are on the leg side, and he is bowling wide. All Gurbaz has to do is steer it past short third
cuts him in two. Beats the diving Karthik too. This is the wobble-seam delivery that jags back in after pitching short of a length. Beats the inside edge, goes over the stumps, and keeps going
short, wide, with no deep fielder on the off side. Gurbaz slashes at it, doesn't bother to keep it down, and gets four for it
this one is pitched outside leg, and is punched wide of mid-on for one
on a length, middle and off, defended
some shape there. Hits the pad, but has started too straight and is missing leg
pushes at a length ball, gets a thick outside edge past point for one
good field placement. Gurbaz jumps out of the crease, flicks on the leg side, deliberately in the air. However, RCB have a deep square leg to keep them down to one. That is good scouting
pushed to mid-on, sent back, and rightly so
slightly short of a length, pushed past midwicket for one
looks for swing. Middle and off, on a length, but it goes with the angle. Pushed to mid-on
perfect delivery. Outswinger ending on top of off. Gurbaz has to defend it

what outfield. Short of a length, some width there, Gurbaz throws his hands at it, Willey at deep third has not far to go to cover it, but he is rushed into it. He does so, gets behind the ball, is down to field it, but gets a bad bounce, which defeats him and goes for four
just short of a length, outside off, pushed to point
outswinger. On the money. Left alone outside off
that is wild. Gurbaz looks to step down to counter the movement, but Siraj slips down leg, and the ball keeps moving away from the keeper. They would have needed a leg gully to stop this
okay this one stays low as Gurbaz leaves it alone outside off
whoa. Pace, bounce and movement. Just short of a length, seam away, and Gurbaz does well to not follow it

very good catch by Varun! He ended up where an imaginary midwicket fielder would have been, diving forward to complete the catch. There were two others rushing towards the ball, but Varun kept his eyes on it, not getting distracted by Gurbaz reaching so close to his left. The ball was flirted up right into the clouds, as Deep went heaving at this full ball, only to get a top edge. KKR win by 81 runs
shapes to slam that away, but ends up pushing at this length ball turning into leg
good length ball turning away to end outside off. Clipped to deep midwicket
swats this off the toe-end of the bat to long-off, as the ball is on a good length outside off
turns in off a good length, and ends on middle. Dabbed back
low full toss on leg, as he hangs deep in the crease. Drilled to long-off
charges down the pitch, and deposits that farrr beyond long-on! That went quite high, as he tore into this length ball outside off to absolutely bash that away
full ball hinting to turn away. Pushed to cover from off stump
launches this down the ground! Full and loopy just outside off, as he goes down the pitch for four
short and wide of off. Turning away, and he misses his slash

bottom edge, and four more! So RCB won't lose by a hundred runs. Rather, they wouldn't have anyway after the previous single. Full ball outside off, as Deep went slogging across the line for third ball he has faced today
keeps a bit low off a good length on off. Clipped to deep midwicket
much fuller, and outside off. Turns away a bit, as he is beaten on his push
turns in off a shortish length and hits his pad as he misses his flick
shortish and wider of off. Pushed towards cover
clips this good length ball on off to deep square, and they pinch two

a one-bounce four! That was sent up a few miles in the air, as again Deep went hoicking at this full delivery on off. Thakur from deep midwicket chased to his left and even stuck his left hand out, but couldn't stop that
short and wide of off. Hacked to deep point
on the bounce to deep square rushing to his right. Full and tossed up on off, as Deep heaved across the line

An animated appeal by Suyash, and not given. The ball went to the slip fielder after Karn missed his sweep, and KKR review. That was bowled from the back of the hand, on a full length on middle and off. Karn swept but missed, and there looks like no bat involved. Ah, UltraEdge detects a faint bottom edge. But Karn is gone even then, since the ball had carried to slip. So he is given caught, and Suyash has his third
full outside off, and driven wide of long-off
another flashy drive at a full ball outside off, as he gets an outside edge to short third
shortish on off, and dabbed to point's left
slower ball again, but this is shortish and on top of off. Hacked to point
change of pace. On a good length on just outside off, and guided between deep third and deep point
punched between mid-off and extra cover! Good length ball, angling across after pitching outside off. It ended wide-ish of off, as Willey swatted it away
short and quite wide of off. Fenced to deep point
short delivery on middle, and clipped to deep backward square
beats the outside edge! Full and flatter, hints to turn away to finish outside off, as Karn looks to defend

another one finds short third! Suyash strikes again, as the mystery spinners continue to have a roll. This one was full and a bit loopy outside off, inviting the big loft from the batter, with Karthik going for it. The ball took off from the outside edge, and flew to short third's right for a simple take
short ball pitching wide of off, and goes further away. Wide called, as Karthik let it go
turns away off a short length, and ends outside off. Clipped towards deep midwicket
full ball turns away to end outside off. Pushed to cover

finds short third! Impact Sub gets his counterpart. Top-edged to the fielder there, as he saw this full delivery tossed up just outside off. It hinted to turn away - as Suyash had good revs on the ball - with Rawat going for the big heave across the line. But he got a top edge, and found the fielder
full and outside off, angling away wider. Left alone
slower ball, on a length just outside off. Tickled to deep third
short delivery on middle and leg, and angles across with Rawat swaying away
shorter side of a length on middle, and tapped down

gloved to short fine! Good catch by Rana tumbling forward. Thakur banged it in short again - this time to the left-hander - and pitched it just about on leg stump. Bracewell pulled, but the extra bounce played a part in him not timing it well. The ball ballooned up for a good take by the KKR captain
much fuller ball on middle, and flicked to fine leg
pulled to deep midwicket's right! Short ball angling in to finish just outside off, as he rammed that into the boundary
good length, turning away to end outside off. Punched to extra cover
turns in off a shortish length, as he gets a bottom edge on to his pad while trying to pull. The ball dribbles towards midwicket
turns away off a length to end on leg. Slog swept to fine leg
pulled over long-on! Short ball, quicker and flatter on off, as this one doesn't turn. Bracewell tears into it for a big six
turns away off a shortish length, and ends this outside off. Bracewell is down the pitch, and ends up pushing it back
turns in off a good length from outside off, as this ball ends closer to off. Punched to wide long-off
slog sweeps this full ball from outside off to deep backward square
short ball turning in from outside off. Cut hard to deep point
much fuller ball just outside off, and dabbed back
pushed between point and short third! Off the outside half of the bat though, as Narine went short and outside off
short and wide of off. Slapped to deep backward point
good length ball straightening on middle and leg. Clipped to short fine
full just outside off, and pushed to mid-on

picks deep point! That was actually well struck, as Shahbaz went reverse sweeping. The fielder in the deep moved a few steps to right to gobble that. Narine went much fuller this time, angling it into the left-hander, as the ball ended on off stump. Shahbaz rolled his wrists and struck nicely, only to unfortunately find the fielder
skips down, and clips this shortish ball turning into middle to deep midwicket
shortish length outside off, and clipped towards deep midwicket
four byes... at least something for RCB. Full and wide of off, as Shahbaz swept and missed, and the keeper was beaten too
very full on middle, and flicked to deep midwicket
looks to defend but gets a leading edge back to the bowler, as it's a length ball on the stumps
full just outside off, and tapped down towards point

another inside edge, and bowled him again! That was quicker from Varun too, and was another googly. That is now four bowleds. Bowls from the back of the hand - and the googly - on a good length outside off. Harshal goes pushing hard, as the turn in finds the gap between his bat and pad. This time it is the middle and leg stumps that are disturbed
full and flatter outside off. Driven to cover

bowled him again! Once again it's the off stump that is uprooted. From the back of the hand, and on the shorter side of a length. That pitched just outside off, and turned in and bounced nicely enough for the bowler's liking, as Maxwell went swinging hard and across the line, but was completely foxed. He lost his shape, as Varun struck again
slog sweeps this very full on the stumps to fine leg
finds cover-point with an expansive drive off this length ball on off
again comes into middle from a good length just outside off. Pushed to deep midwicket
skips out, and looks to flick this good length ball turning in from outside off. Hit on his pad, but was heading down
full and just outside off, hints to straighten after pitching. Pushed to point
full and on the stumps. Tucked to long-on
skips out, and pushes this length ball angled in to long-on
almost chops on! He also goes for a wild hack, as this ball is on a good length outside off and turns in. Luckily for him, the ball drops on to his leg off the bottom edge
drilled between point and cover! This one shapes to turn away off a length, and finishes just outside off. Drives late, and gets four
good length ball, angles in to hit his pad as he misses his clip
drives down at this flatter and fuller ball outside off, and finds cover

another mystery spinner strikes for KKR! Now du Plessis' turn to be cleaned up. Varun tosses it up a bit, and goes on a slightly shorter side of a length outside off. That was bowled from back of the hand, and hinted to turn in, as du Plessis went for an expansive drive but got an inside edge. RCB's chase gets derailed just after they had started well
full ball angled into off, as he gets a leading edge while trying to flick. The ball runs past slip
turns in off a length to end on his pads. Flicked to fine leg

gone, the off stump is plucked! Eden is up in celebration. Kohli went to play across the line, but missed this fullish ball which pitched just outside off. It was flicked from the front of the hand, and turned in nicely enough for Narine to strike in his first over. RCB lose an early wicket in a big chase
good length ball, turning in and ending just outside leg. Flicked, but right to square leg again
length ball on the stumps, and turned to square leg
turns in off a good length, and ends on his pads. Clipped to square leg
length ball just outside off. Pushed to short third
good length on middle and off, and pushed down
the shorter boundary into play! Runs are flowing here. Slower ball from Southee, but his line and length weren't there: it was close to being a on a length, and around. Swung over midwicket
clubbed to deep extra cover! Southee now went wider of off, but again on a length, as du Plessis opened the bat face to send that flashing over the fielder
flung over mid-on! Du Plessis joins the fun in the over. Again he is deep in the crease, as this length ball arrives just outside off, and he swings across the line
length ball this time, and angles into middle. Again Kohli skips out, and clips wide of mid-on. Varun there chases the ball, and they pinch three
jumps down, and goes over the bowler's head! On a good length on off, and hints to angle in after pitching. Kohli lofts down, even as the bat face half-closes
punches this good length ball on off to extra cover
lofted over extra cover! Sits deep in the crease, and Umesh bowls a near yorker in the channel outside off. du Plessis opened the bat face, and went inside out
drives this length ball around off between mid-off and extra cover for a single
again finds point with his poke, as this good length delivery is bowled outside off
opens the bat face to stab this good length ball which pitched around sixth stump
off the higher side of the bat, and just over mid-on. Kohli walks down again, as Umesh digs it into the pitch and just outside off. Kohli half-pulled, and without any timing
gets across with a slight step forward, and dabs at this length ball just outside off. Single to midwicket
now goes chasing this wide ball outside off. It's not called wide, and Kohli isn't amused. Shortish on sixth stump, and angles away as Kohli skips down, flashes and is beaten
goes much fuller on off, and is driven to mid-on
walks down, but is completely beaten! Length ball just outside off, angled in, but straightens after pitching as Kohli looks to flick but misses
again some away movement off a good length from outside off. Pushed to point for a hurried single
goes flashing but withdraws his bat last moment. Good length slightly wide of off, and it darts away further
tucked between point and short third! Just uses the pace of the bowler in guiding that shortish delivery which is a bit wide of off to end the over with a four after starting with one
bunts it off the inside half of the bat to midwicket, as Umesh bowls on a good length just outside off
gets good bounce off a good length, shaping it in to hit du Plessis' stomach on leg stump as the batter fends and misses
length ball on leg stump, and pushed wide of mid-on
dabs it on the bounce to point, as Umesh now goes on the shorter side of a length outside off
flicked for four first ball! Eden doesn't mind. Quite full and angled into his pads, as Kohli lets that go to short fine's left
